name: explora en Rapa Nui, Posada de Mike
positioning: All-inclusive lodge on Easter Island, now called Explora Rapa Nui, set on grasslands outside Hanga Roa with Pacific views, architecture by Jose Cruz Ovalle, a spa, sauna, outdoor pool and hot tub, and guided small-group Explorations
best_for: Active travelers who want guided hiking, biking and paddling Explorations to moai sites included in the stay
Design lovers drawn to contemporary architecture inspired by the moai
Couples who want a spa, sauna, pool and hot tub between days of exploring

facts.text: The lodge sits in a secluded spot on Easter Island, surrounded by trees, grasslands and far-reaching views over the Pacific Ocean.
The lodge is a short distance from the main town of Hanga Roa and central to trailheads and archaeological sites.
The lodge was designed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.
Rooms and suites have natural wood interiors, ocean or garden views and jetted bathtubs.
The Raa Suite takes its name from the Rapa Nui word for the sun.
Varua, the name of the standard rooms, is a Polynesian word meaning spirit or soul.
The lodge has a sauna as part of its wellness facilities.
Guided Explorations include hiking to the Rano Raraku moai quarry, biking to ancient ahu platforms, and kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding along the volcanic coastline.
Guides are trained at Explora's own School of Guides and are fluent in Spanish and English.
Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations.
The menu features local ingredients such as sweet potatoes, taro, fresh Pacific seafood and tropical fruits including Rapa Nui pineapple.
The stay includes all guided Explorations, all meals and beverages, spa facility access, national park entrance fees and round-trip transfers from Mataveri International Airport.

highlights.text: The lodge's interconnected volumes are reminiscent of the arrangement of the moai statues.
The lodge has a full-service spa, Hare Vaka, offering massage and body treatments including options inspired by Polynesian and Rapa Nui wellness traditions.
An outdoor swimming pool and hot tub sit within the lodge grounds with views across the grasslands toward the Pacific Ocean.
Explorations include sunset bike rides to the massive moai ahu at Tongariki.
Explorations are limited to groups of no more than eight guests.

considerations.text: Getting there means a flight of approximately 5 hours from Santiago to Easter Island.
Because of the remote location, Wi-Fi in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability.
Individual spa treatments are booked separately and carry an additional charge.
